architecture_authority_ref: VF-SHW-X2 report/evidence on top of the accepted X1/X1-C01 contract layer; the single canonical session/bridge/run authority is unchanged
objective: Make the X2 whole-plant runtime the canonical default of the normal shwtp session/runtime/UI resolution path while keeping g21_slice reachable only through an explicit compatibility selector/factory with unchanged accepted behaviour; thread and verify the four authority labels (site_truth=false, simulation_truth=synthetic_reference, vf_runtime_authorization=NOT_AUTHORIZED, site_authorized_execution=NOT_AUTHORIZED) through every X2 transfer/monitor/control/runtime-truth projection with fail-closed assertions, keeping implementation state (IMPLEMENTED_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE) separate from authorization state (NOT_AUTHORIZED) and correcting the report contradiction; and replace the weak/tautological tests (contract signature, DP monotonicity, conditional assertions) with tests that fail when the named invariant is deliberately violated.
explicit_non_objectives: No change to any frozen X1 config/contract (configs/** stays untouched)
No new scope, no topology change, no control-class change, no fidelity-class upgrade
No C2 activation, no PI/PID dynamics, no T107
No PIM change and no PIM semantic change
forbidden_paths_note: tests/ is intentionally NOT listed as a whole-directory forbidden entry: making whole_plant_x2 the canonical default necessarily migrates the accepted G22/G23/G24/G25 assertions that pinned the G21 slice as the default, so those four modules are individually allowlisted. The frozen X1 contract layer (configs/** and contracts.py) is NOT edited; the frozen X2-active C1 set (x2_controls.py) is NOT edited. ui/workspace_monitor.py is allowlisted only as the single canonical SH-WTP view resolution point (no new UI authority, no new page); every other UI module stays forbidden.

Changing any frozen X1 config/contract or the whole-plant graph signature

stop_conditions: Making the whole plant the canonical default would require changing a frozen X1 config/contract
The accepted G21 slice behaviour cannot be preserved through an explicit compatibility selector
A required authority label cannot be attached to a projection without changing its accepted semantics
A correction would require a new scope/topology/control/fidelity or a C2 activation

acceptance_criteria.description: whole_plant_x2 is the canonical default of the normal shwtp session/runtime/UI path (one RuntimeSession, one run identity, one bridge, 16 admitted scopes) and g21_slice is reachable only through an explicit compatibility selector/factory whose accepted behaviour stays green

The four authority labels (site_truth=false, simulation_truth=synthetic_reference, vf_runtime_authorization=NOT_AUTHORIZED, site_authorized_execution=NOT_AUTHORIZED) are present and verified on every applicable X2 transfer/monitor/control/runtime-truth/balance/input-wiring/provenance/assumed-topology projection and on the SH-WTP view, with a fail-closed guard that rejects a missing or mutated label

Implementation state and authorization state are reported separately (whole_plant_runtime=IMPLEMENTED_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE, whole_plant_runtime_authorization=NOT_AUTHORIZED) and the report contradiction is corrected

Weak/tautological tests are replaced by tests that fail when the named invariant is deliberately violated: contract signature (mutations of covered admission fields change it / are rejected), DP monotonicity (per-cycle assertions + a bite test), and no remaining conditional assertion that proves nothing
No frozen config/contract, scope, topology, control, fidelity or PIM/ASSY surface changed; the canonical baseline and the full suite are green at the pushed head
